terra.problem: The passage describes cherubim worked into the linen curtains, not artwork on every curtain in the tent.
Laughing that the choice is the exact opposite of what God says risks making the baker's missed answer the joke.
The passage says the veil separates the two places; it does not call the veil a door.
The reference to an upper room elsewhere in the Bible needs a citation.
The passage places the ark behind the veil, but does not say it is the only thing there.
Saying the baker can hear Ruby now suggests knowledge of what his cookie cutter kid is doing. He may only remember her.
The poles are acacia wood overlaid with bronze, not made of bronze.
The utensils are made of bronze, not merely overlaid with it.
The instruction is to keep the lamps burning continually; the explanation presents that as an accomplished fact.
The statement that Moses is Israel's leader needs a supporting reference outside this passage; Exodus 4:14 supports the sibling relationship.
Identifying Aaron as Moses' brother needs a reference outside this passage.
